ядра.подтема: Что такое C2PA Content Credentials и чего они не гарантируют
ядра.ядро_en: C2PA metadata utilizes cryptographically signed metadata to provide secure and verifiable records of a media file's origin and any changes it's undergone; being cryptographically signed, this information is tamper-evident. C2PA doesn't classify media as "real" or "fake": it focuses on authenticating the source and ensures that the content hasn't been tampered with — even an AI-generated image is regarded as "authentic" if it has valid Content Credentials. C2PA doesn't guarantee the truthfulness of the assertions in the Content Credentials; the consumer of the media file is responsible for deciding whether the source is trustworthy.
